author: Stephen Crane
title: The Red Badge of Courage: An Episode of the American Civil War
edition: Wikisource transcription (Index: Red Badge of Courage (1895).djvu) of New York: D. Appleton and Company, 1895 (copyright 1894, 1895). Every selected word was collated against OCR of a dated Appleton scan (Internet Archive redbadgeofcourag00cranrich, 1896 printing, copyright 1895) with Project Gutenberg #73 as a second witness; one Wikisource misreading ('lie' for 'He') was corrected, and the Appleton readings that differ from Gutenberg (e.g. 'wide bank', 'cammand', 'Se he went', 'with a air') were confirmed on the page images. Dialect spellings and apostrophe spacing are retained as printed; HTML presentation removed and whitespace normalized. The library holds the whole novel, Chapters I–XXIV, with their chapter headings. The collation and correction above cover the passages used as nightly readings; elsewhere the Wikisource transcription is reproduced as transcribed.

rights.basis: Original English novel published in 1895 by D. Appleton and Company, before 1931; its US term has expired as of 2026. The dated scan is marked NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.

acquisition.method: MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text|revid) for the Wikisource subpages Chapter 1–24 of Red_Badge_of_Courage_(1895), fetched in the printed order of the main page (revisions 7729471–7790128); downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the twenty-four JSON responses concatenated in that order. Removed the Wikisource header, page-number anchors, licence and other no-export elements; each HTML paragraph, and each run of text set directly in a section, became a paragraph with whitespace (including no-break spaces) collapsed to single spaces and italics dropped to plain text; centred verse with line breaks became stanzas; the centred chapter titles became level-2 headings. The one correction the nightly selections carry from the edition’s declared collation (‘lie’ to ‘He’) was applied at the same place.
